status: Partial controller and normal boss-route implementation; not full port acceptance.

69.0.0.movement: Teleports to random positions away from player.
69.0.0.targeting: Player-relative teleport separation; volleys use fixed cardinal/diagonal axes.
69.0.0.attacks: Four cardinal shots, four diagonal, four cardinal; alternative eight-shot ring or Boom Fly summon. Whole-heart contact.
69.0.0.vulnerability: Source350HP, no stageHP. Meat Cleaver converts into Lokii rather than generic duplication.
69.0.0.phases: Independent teleport/attack cycles; optional Poky or four corner Stone Grimaces are encounter-specific support.
69.0.0.offspring: Boom Fly25.0.0, at most four live. Meat Cleaver split uses69.1.0.
69.0.0.completion: Root defeat pays encounter once; summoned threats and optional invulnerable support need explicit local room-clear policy.
69.0.0.adaptations: 350 source HP per body becomes1120 using the established x3.2 conversion; contact20 becomes25 through the existing hostile multiplier. World-space fixed volley axes, safe grounded teleports, local action weights/timings in loki.mechanics. Lokii shares a one-fly live/pending cap across both halves. Independent body IDs share one bossGroup; initial pair placement is atomic. Dead-half metadata persists until final death for aggregate HUD/attack cleanup. Children survive the boss and still block ordinary room clear. Existing story evidence remains necessary for floor exit.
unknowns: Native action weights, volley intervals, vanish/reappear windows and teleport distance are unmeasured; configured values are explicit local tuning.
Meat Cleaver conversion from Loki into Lokii is not yet implemented.
Loki optional Poky/four-corner Stone Grimace room variants and degraded/Double Trouble/challenge/boss-rush/Void routes remain missing.
Shared versus per-half source Red Boom Fly cap needs native confirmation; the current shared cap is a declared local interpretation.
No human/mixed-build or rendered Linux/WASM performance acceptance is claimed by this checkpoint.

69.1.0.offspring: Red Boom Fly25.1.0 with maximum one alive. Whether the source cap is shared across both halves needs native confirmation.
69.1.0.completion: Both halves must be resolved before a single encounter payout; Red children retain ordinary hostile lifetime.
